entities.summary: Nanyue, a notable figure in the history of Vietnam, associated with Chinese Domination Period (207 BCE–40). Preceded by Nanyue and Han Conquest and Zhao Tuo establishes the Nanyue kingdom encompassing northern Vietnam. Their legacy influenced Trung Sisters and Vietnamese Resistance and Lady Trieu.
